transactions.desc: The Angels promoted Bremner from High-A Tri-City to Double-A Rocket City on Tuesday.
The Miami Marlins traded INF Adrian Santana to the Tampa Bay Rays.
The Pirates selected Simon's contract from Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday.
The Diamondbacks recalled Abner from Triple-A Reno on Wednesday, Jody Jackson of Bally Sports Arizona reports.
The Diamondbacks optioned Del Castillo to Triple-A Reno on Wednesday, Jody Jackson of Bally Sports Arizona reports.
Moreno (personal) will serve as the designated hitter and bat in the cleanup spot against San Diego on Wednesday, Jody Jackson of Bally Sports Arizona reports.
The Brewers reinstated Harrison (forearm) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Wednesday versus the Pirates in Milwaukee.
The Nationals designated Littell for assignment Wednesday.
Cincinnati recalled Mey from Triple-A Louisville on Wednesday.
Washington activated Lord (side) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The Padres designated Marquez for assignment Wednesday.
The Angels recalled Saucedo from Triple-A Salt Lake on Wednesday.
The Blue Jays claimed Waldron off waivers from the Padres on Wednesday.
Milwaukee optioned Anderson to Triple-A Nashville on Wednesday.
The Miami Marlins traded INF Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.
The Pirates reinstated Devenski (illness) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday and outrighted him to Triple-A Indianapolis.
Pittsburgh optioned Dotel to Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday.
Pittsburgh reinstated Sisk (elbow) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The Angels promoted Alvarez from Single-A Rancho Cucamonga to High-A Tri-City on Tuesday.
The Guardians recalled Genao from Triple-A Columbus on Wednesday.
Cleveland designated Arias for assignment Wednesday.
The Cubs optioned Kelly to Triple-A Iowa on Wednesday.
The White Sox reinstated Hays (calf) from the 60-day injured list and designated him for assignment Wednesday.
Baltimore optioned Nunez to Triple-A Norfolk on Wednesday.
The Blue Jays recalled Lee from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday.
Toronto recalled Estrada from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday.
Toronto demoted Dallas to Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday.
The Nationals released Wiemer on Wednesday.
The Rangers reinstated Bradford (elbow) from the 60-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Wednesday versus the Giants in Arlington.
The Mets released Tauchman on Wednesday.
